summary: ADVERSARIAL H001: Mixed results. (1) ENSO confound: after removing ENSO signal, BOTH cloud→albedo AND albedo→cloud become significant — the original 'unidirectional' Granger result was partly an ENSO confound. Cloud buffering is BIDIRECTIONAL feedback, not one-way. WEAKENED. (2) Temporal aggregation: quarterly Granger significant (p=0.002), annual marginal (p=0.05). MOSTLY SURVIVES. (3) Rolling slope: cloud→albedo slope NEVER reverses across 241 5-year windows — SURVIVES. Overall: H001 mechanism is real but the 'unidirectional' claim is weakened to 'bidirectional feedback'.
